```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# liczba rdzeni do budowy modeli, w moim przypadku 6
cores <- 6

Sys.setenv(TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS = "0") # brak różnic w dokładności obliczeń
Sys.setenv(PYTHONHASHSEED = "2027") # ziarno dla Python
Sys.setenv(TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL = "3") # tylko logi o błędach krytycznych tensorflow
Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = as.character(cores)) # ograniczenie do 6 rdzeni
Sys.setenv(TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS = as.character(cores)) # 6 rdzeni do obliczeń mlp
Sys.setenv(TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS = "1") # determinizm niezależnych obliczeń

library(tidyverse)
```

## Wczytanie danych

```{r}

set.seed(2027)

dane_modelowe <- readRDS("dane/dane_modelowe.rds")

split <- readRDS("dane/split.rds")

train <- training(split)
validation <- validation(split)
test <- testing(split)

# weryfikacja zbioru walidacyjnego
validation_set_tuning <- validation_set(split)

v <- assessment(validation_set_tuning$splits[[1]])

# Sprawdzenie liczby wierszy i kolumn
dim(v)
dim(validation)

# Sprawdzenie identyczności zbiorów walidacyjnych
all.equal(v, validation)

metryki <- metric_set(rsq, mae, rmse, mape)

# split do early stopping
set.seed(2027)

train_split <- initial_split(
  train,
  prop = 0.9,
  strata = car_price
)

train90 <- training(train_split)
train_es <- testing(train_split)

cat("Train: ", nrow(train90), "\n",
    "Train early stopping: ", nrow(train_es), "\n", sep = "")

options(scipen = 999)
```

## Regresja liniowa z Elastic Net

```{r}

tuning_elastic_net <- readRDS("tuning/tuning_elastic_net.rds")

best_elastic_net <- select_best(tuning_elastic_net, metric = "rmse")

cat("Najlepsze lambda (penalty) i alfa (mixture) - Elastic Net:")
print(best_elastic_net) # penalty (lambda) i mixture (alfa)

final_elastic_net_model <- readRDS("modele/final_elastic_net_model.rds")

train_predictions_elastic_net <- augment(final_elastic_net_model, new_data = train) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_elastic_net_train <- metryki(
  train_predictions_elastic_net, 
  truth = price_gbp, 
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
         zbior = "Treningowy")

val_predictions_elastic_net <- augment(final_elastic_net_model, new_data = validation) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_elastic_net_val <- metryki(
  val_predictions_elastic_net,
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
         zbior = "Walidacyjny")

test_predictions_elastic_net <- augment(final_elastic_net_model, new_data = test) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_elastic_net_test <- metryki(
  test_predictions_elastic_net, 
  truth = price_gbp, 
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
         zbior = "Testowy")

wyniki_elastic_net <- bind_rows(wyniki_elastic_net_train, wyniki_elastic_net_val, wyniki_elastic_net_test) |>
  dplyr::select(model, zbior, .metric, .estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

wyniki_elastic_net


breaks <- c(1000, 10000, 50000, 200000)
labels = c("1 tys.", "10 tys.", "50 tys.", "200 tys.")
# wartości rzeczywiste vs Przewidywane (zbiór testowy)
ggplot(test_predictions_elastic_net, aes(x = price_gbp, 
                                         y = predicted_price_gbp))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "midnightblue")+
  geom_abline(lty = 2, color = "red", linewidth = 1)+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, labels = labels)+
  scale_y_log10(breaks = breaks, labels = labels)+
  labs(
    title = "Regresja Liniowa (Elastic Net): Rzeczywiste vs Przewidywane Ceny",
    subtitle = "Prezentacja na skali logarytmicznej",
    x = "Prawdziwa cena [GBP]",
    y = "Przewidywana cena [GBP]"
  )+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)
```

## Random Forest

```{r}

recipe_rf <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train) |>

  # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
  
  # Ochrona przed brakami danych
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
  
  # Target encoding dla marki i modelu z kurczeniem Bayesa
  step_lencode_mixed(make, model, outcome = vars(car_price)) |>
  
  # Grupowanie do kategorii "inne" dla rzadkich kategorii poniżej 0,1%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.001, other = "inne") |>
  
  # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
  step_zv(all_predictors())


recipe_prepped_rf <- prep(recipe_rf, training = train)

train_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = NULL))
validation_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = validation))
test_rf <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, new_data = test))
```

```{r}

  car_price = validation$car_price,
  .pred = preds_val_rf
) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),

  )

wyniki_rf_val <- metryki(

) |>

test_predictions_rf <- data.frame(
  car_price = test$car_price,
  .pred = preds_test_rf
) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),

  )

wyniki_rf_test <- metryki(

wyniki_rf <- bind_rows(wyniki_rf_train, wyniki_rf_val, wyniki_rf_test) |>

# wartości rzeczywiste vs Przewidywane (zbiór testowy)
ggplot(test_predictions_rf, aes(x = price_gbp, y = predicted_price_gbp))+

  labs(
    title = "Random Forest: Rzeczywiste vs Przewidywane Ceny",
```

## XGBoost

`Recipe` dla modeli boostingowych

```{r}

recipe_boosting <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
  
  # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
  
  # Ochrona przed brakami danych
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
  
  # Usuwanie marek i modeli pojawiających się poniżej 10 razy
  step_other(make, model, threshold = 10, other = "inne") |>
  
  # Usuwanie grup factorów o udziale poniżej 0.1%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), -make, -model, threshold = 0.001,
             other = "inne") |>
  
  # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
  step_zv(all_predictors())


recipe_prepped_boosting <- prep(recipe_boosting, training = train90)

train_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = NULL)
train_es_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = train_es)
validation_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = validation)
test_xgb_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = test)

X_train_xgb <- train_xgb_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_train_xgb <- train_xgb_baked$car_price

train_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_train_xgb,
  label = y_train_xgb
)

X_es_xgb <- train_es_xgb_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_es_xgb <- train_es_xgb_baked$car_price

train_es_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_es_xgb,
  label = y_es_xgb
)

X_val_xgb <- validation_xgb_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_val_xgb <- validation_xgb_baked$car_price

validation_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_val_xgb,
  label = y_val_xgb
)

X_test_xgb <- test_xgb_baked |>
  dplyr::select(-car_price)
y_test_xgb <- test_xgb_baked$car_price

test_xgb <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_test_xgb,
  label = y_test_xgb
)
```

## LightGBM

```{r}

train_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = NULL)
train_es_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = train_es)
validation_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = validation)
test_lgbm_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, new_data = test)

zmienne_kategoryczne <- train_lgbm_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  dplyr::select(where(is.factor)) |> 
  colnames()

X_train_lgbm <- train_lgbm_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  data.matrix()
y_train_lgbm <- train_lgbm_baked$car_price

X_es_lgbm <- train_es_lgbm_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  data.matrix()
y_es_lgbm <- train_es_lgbm_baked$car_price

X_val_lgbm <- validation_lgbm_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  data.matrix()
y_val_lgbm <- validation_lgbm_baked$car_price

X_test_lgbm <- test_lgbm_baked |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  data.matrix()
y_test_lgbm <- test_lgbm_baked$car_price


train_lgbm <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = X_train_lgbm,
  label = y_train_lgbm,
  categorical_feature = zmienne_kategoryczne,
  params = list(feature_pre_filter = FALSE)
)

train_es_lgbm <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = X_es_lgbm,
  label = y_es_lgbm,
  reference = train_lgbm
)
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_catboost_val <- metryki(
  val_predictions_catboost,
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "CatBoost",
         zbior = "Walidacyjny")

preds_test_catboost <- catboost.predict(
  model = final_catboost,
  pool = test_catboost
) |> 
  as.vector()

test_predictions_catboost <- data.frame(
  car_price = test$car_price,
  .pred = preds_test_catboost
) |>
  mutate(
    price_gbp = exp(car_price),
    predicted_price_gbp = exp(.pred)
  )

wyniki_catboost_test <- metryki(
  test_predictions_catboost,
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |>
  mutate(model = "CatBoost",
         zbior = "Testowy")


wyniki_catboost <- bind_rows(wyniki_catboost_train, wyniki_catboost_val, wyniki_catboost_test) |>
  dplyr::select(model, zbior, .metric, .estimate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

wyniki_catboost
```

## Sieć neuronowa MLP

```{r}

recipe_mlp <- recipe(car_price ~ ., data = train90) |>
  
  # Ochrona przed nowymi kategoriami
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "inne") |>
  
  # Ochrona przed brakami danych
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "nieznane") |>
  
  # Target encoding dla marki i modelu z kurczeniem Bayesa
  step_lencode_mixed(make, model, outcome = vars(car_price)) |>
  
  # Grupowanie do kategorii "inne" dla rzadkich kategorii poniżej 0,1%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.001, other = "inne") |>
  
  # Zamiana pozostałych zmiennych kategorycznych na zmienne binarne
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) |>
  
  # Profilaktyczne usuwanie stałych kolumn
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |> 
  
  # Normalizacja predyktorów numerycznych
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

recipe_prepped_mlp <- prep(recipe_mlp, training = train90)

train_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = NULL)
train_es_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = train_es)
val_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = validation)
test_mlp <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, new_data = test)

X_train_mlp <- train_mlp |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  as.matrix()
y_train_mlp <- train_mlp$car_price

X_train_es_mlp <- train_es_mlp |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  as.matrix()
y_train_es_mlp <- train_es_mlp$car_price

X_val_mlp <- val_mlp |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  as.matrix()
y_val_mlp <- val_mlp$car_price

X_test_mlp <- test_mlp |> 
  dplyr::select(-car_price) |> 
  as.matrix()
y_test_mlp <- test_mlp$car_price
```

Tabela do wizualizacji łącznych czasów i wyników metryk modeli

```{r}

tabela <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)",
    "Random Forest",
    "XGBoost",
    "LightGBM",
    "CatBoost",
    "MLP"
  ),
  czas_tuning_sekundy = c(
    sekundy_tuning_elastic_net,
    sekundy_tuning_rf,
    sekundy_tuning_xgb,
    sekundy_tuning_lgbm,
    sekundy_tuning_catboost,
    sekundy_tuning_mlp
  ),
  czas_trening_sekundy = c(
    sekundy_fit_elastic_net,
    sekundy_fit_rf,
    sekundy_fit_xgb,
    sekundy_fit_lgbm,
    sekundy_fit_catboost,
    sekundy_fit_mlp
  ),
  mape = c(
    wyniki_elastic_net$mape[3],
    wyniki_rf$mape[3],
    wyniki_xgb$mape[3],
    wyniki_lgbm$mape[3],
    wyniki_catboost$mape[3],
    wyniki_mlp$mape[3]
  )
) |> 
  mutate(
    laczny_czas_minuty = (czas_tuning_sekundy + czas_trening_sekundy)/60
  )
```

Wizualizacja: Błąd MAPE a łączny czas tuningu

```{r}

czasy <- ggplot(tabela, aes(x = laczny_czas_minuty, y = mape))+
  geom_point(aes(color = model), size = 5)+
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 30, 60, 120, 240, 360, 540),
    labels = c("1 min", "30 min", "1 h", "2 h", "4 h", "6h", "9 h")
  )+
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = model),
    fontface = "bold",
    direction = "both", # przysuwanie etykiet
    nudge_y = 0.6, # początkowe przesunięcie etykiet w górę
    box.padding = 0.5, # dodatkowa przestrzeń wokół tekstów
    size = 3, # wielkość etykiet
    point.padding = 0.4, # odsunięcie tekstu od punktu
    max.overlaps = Inf, # widoczność wszystkich etykiet
    min.segment.length = Inf, # brak linii wskazujących do etykiet
    seed = 2027
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)" = "#8806d4",
      "Random Forest" = "#008521",
      "XGBoost" = "#0068c7",
      "LightGBM" = "#f7820c",
      "CatBoost" = "#cf0295",
      "MLP" = "#d90707"
    )
  )+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7)
        )+
  labs(
    x = "Łączny czas tuningu i treningu",
    y = "Błąd MAPE na zbiorze testowym [%]"
  )
czasy

)
```

## Błędy modeli

Podział na 3 kategorie cenowe wg kwartylu rozkładu ceny pojazdów

- Cena niska: **0 - 25 %**

- Cena średnia: **25 % – 75 %**

- Cena wysoka: **75 % – 100 %**

```{r}

test_gbp <- test |> 
  mutate(price_gbp = exp(car_price))

kwartyl1 <- quantile(test_gbp$price_gbp, probs = 0.25) # 1 kwartyl
kwartyl3 <- quantile(test_gbp$price_gbp, probs = 0.75) # 3 kwartyl
```

### Elastic Net

```{r}

test_predictions_elastic_net <- test_predictions_elastic_net |>
  mutate(
    price_group = case_when(
      price_gbp <= kwartyl1 ~ "low",
      price_gbp < kwartyl3 ~ "medium",
      TRUE ~ "high"
    )
  )

wyniki_price_groups_elastic_net_low <- metryki(
  test_predictions_elastic_net |> 
    dplyr::filter(price_group == "low"),
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |> 
  mutate(price_group = "low")

wyniki_price_groups_elastic_net_medium <- metryki(
  test_predictions_elastic_net |> 
    dplyr::filter(price_group == "medium"),
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |> 
  mutate(price_group = "medium")

wyniki_price_groups_elastic_net_high <- metryki(
  test_predictions_elastic_net |> 
    dplyr::filter(price_group == "high"),
  truth = price_gbp,
  estimate = predicted_price_gbp
) |> 
  mutate(price_group = "high")

bledy_elastic_net <- rbind(wyniki_price_groups_elastic_net_low,
                           wyniki_price_groups_elastic_net_medium,
                           wyniki_price_groups_elastic_net_high)

bledy_elastic_net <- bledy_elastic_net |> 
  mutate(.estimate = case_when(
    .metric == "rsq" ~ round(.estimate, 3),
    .metric == "mape" ~ round(.estimate, 2),
    .metric %in% c("mae", "rmse") ~ round(.estimate),
    TRUE ~ .estimate # inne przypadki metryk
  ))

bledy_elastic_net <- bledy_elastic_net |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = .metric,
    values_from = .estimate
  )
```

## Lokalne błędy

```{r}

test_id <- test |> select(-car_price) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number())

test_predictions_xgb_id <- test_predictions_xgb %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number())

full_test_xgb <- test_id %>%
  left_join(test_predictions_xgb_id, by = "id") |> 
  select(-id)
```

Największy i najmniejszy błąd w grupie tanich samochodów (średnio najgorsze wyniki metryk)

```{r}

full_bledy_xgb <- full_test_xgb |> 
  mutate(
    blad_bezwzgledny = abs(price_gbp - predicted_price_gbp),
    blad_procentowy = (blad_bezwzgledny / price_gbp) * 100
  )

id_low <- which(full_bledy_xgb$price_group == "low")

best_pred_low <- id_low[which.min(full_bledy_xgb$blad_procentowy[id_low])]

worst_pred_low <- id_low[which.max(full_bledy_xgb$blad_procentowy[id_low])]
```

**Explainery:**

- Regresja liniowa (Elastic Net)

```{r}

explainer_elastic_net <- DALEX::explain(
  model = final_elastic_net_model, # to workflow (bez dodawania tu recipe)
  data = X_test,
  y = Y_test_GBP,
  predict_function = function(model, data)
  {
    preds <- predict(model, data)$.pred
    return(exp(preds))
  },
  label = "Elastic Net"
)
```

- Random Forest

```{r}

explainer_rf <- DALEX::explain(
  model = final_rf_model,
  data = X_test,
  y = Y_test_GBP,
  predict_function = function(model, data)
  {
    data_baked <- as.data.frame(bake(recipe_prepped_rf, data))
    
    preds <- predict(model, data_baked)$predictions
    return(exp(preds))
  },
  label = "Random Forest"
)
```

- XGBoost

```{r}

explainer_xgboost <- DALEX::explain(
  model = final_xgb,
  data = X_test,
  y = Y_test_GBP,
  predict_function = function(model, data)
  {
    data_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, data)
    dmat <- xgb.DMatrix(
      data = data_baked
    )
    
    preds <- predict(model, newdata = dmat)
    return(exp(preds))
  },
  label = "XGBoost"
)

saveRDS(explainer_xgboost, "dane/explainer_xgboost.rds")
```

- LightGBM

```{r}

explainer_lightgbm <- DALEX::explain(
  model = final_lgbm,
  data = X_test,
  y = Y_test_GBP,
  predict_function = function(model, data)
  {
    data_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, data) |> 
      data.matrix()
    
    preds <- predict(model, newdata = data_baked)
    return(as.vector(exp(preds)))
  },
  label = "LightGBM"
)
```

- CatBoost

```{r}

explainer_catboost <- DALEX::explain(
  model = final_catboost,
  data = X_test,
  y = Y_test_GBP,
  predict_function = function(model, data)
  {
    data_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_boosting, data)
    data_pool <- catboost.load_pool(
      data = data_baked
    )
        
    preds <- catboost.predict(
      model = model,
      pool = data_pool
    ) |> 
      as.vector()
    return(exp(preds))
  },
  label = "CatBoost"
)
```

- MLP

```{r}

explainer_mlp <- DALEX::explain(
  model = model_mlp,
  data = X_test,
  y = Y_test_GBP,
  predict_function = function(model, data)
  {
    data_baked <- bake(recipe_prepped_mlp, data)
    mat <- as.matrix(data_baked)
    
    preds <- predict(model, mat, verbose = 0) |> 
      as.vector()
    return(exp(preds))
  },
  label = "MLP"
)
```

### Wykresy ALE (Accumulated Local Effects)

`miles` (przebieg)

```{r, message=FALSE}

set.seed(2027)

ale_elastic_net_miles <- model_profile(
  explainer = explainer_elastic_net,
  variables = "miles",
  type = "accumulated",
  N = NULL
)

set.seed(2027)

ale_rf_miles <- model_profile(
  explainer = explainer_rf,
  variables = "miles",
  type = "accumulated",
  N = NULL
)

set.seed(2027)

ale_xgboost_miles <- model_profile(
  explainer = explainer_xgboost,
  variables = "miles",
  type = "accumulated",
  N = NULL
)

set.seed(2027)

ale_mlp_miles <- model_profile(
  explainer = explainer_mlp, 
  variables = "miles",
  type = "accumulated",
  N = NULL
)

tys <- function(x)
{
  ifelse(!is.na(x) & x >= 10000,
         paste0(x / 1000, " tys."),
         as.character(x))
}

ale_miles <- plot(ale_elastic_net_miles, ale_rf_miles, ale_xgboost_miles,
                  ale_mlp_miles, size = 0.5)+
  aes(linetype = `_label_`)+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = tys)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(7500, 35000), labels = tys)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Elastic Net" = "#8806d4",
                                "Random Forest" = "#008521",
                                "XGBoost" = "#0068c7",
                                "MLP" = "#d90707"))+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Elastic Net" = "dashed",
                                   "Random Forest" = "twodash",
                                   "XGBoost" = "solid",
                                   "MLP" = "dotdash"))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "none"
  )+
  labs(y = "Średnia prognozowana cena [GBP]",
       x = "Przebieg [mi]")
ale_miles

ggsave(
  filename = "template_latex/rys/ale_miles.pdf",
  plot = ale_miles,
  width = width_2,
  height = height_2,
  units = unit,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

gc()
```

### Istotność zmiennych w modelu XGBoost (Variable Importance)

Metoda permutacyjna

```{r, message=FALSE}

set.seed(2027)

vi_xgboost <- model_parts(
  explainer = explainer_xgboost,
  loss_function = yardstick::mape_vec, # funkcja straty jako MAPE
  N = NULL, # cały zbiór testowy
  B = 10 # 10 powtórzeń permutacji
  )

vi <- plot(vi_xgboost, max_vars = 15, bar_width = 5.5)

vi$layers[[3]] <- NULL # brak zbędnych niebieskich obiektów (całe dane test)
vi$layers[[1]]$aes_params$linewidth <- 0 # usunięcie kropek po lewej

vi <- vi + 
  scale_color_manual(values = "#ba0b0b")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )+
  labs(
    x = "", 
    y = "Wartość błędu MAPE [%] po permutacji zmiennej"
  )
vi

)
```

### Lokalna dekompozycja decyzji predykcyjnych modelu XGBoost

Pojazd z najmniejszym błędem

```{r}

best_pred_low_bd <- X_test[best_pred_low,]
```

**Wykres Break–down**

```{r, message=FALSE}

set.seed(2027)

bd_best <- predict_parts(
  explainer = explainer_xgboost,
  new_observation = best_pred_low_bd,
  type = "break_down",
  N = NULL
)

bd1 <- plot(bd_best, digits = 0)
bd1$coordinates$clip <- "off"

# "," zamiast "," na wykresie
sc1 <- bd1$scales$get_scales("x")
sc1$labels <- gsub("(?<=\\d)\\.(?=\\d)", ",", sc1$labels, perl = TRUE)

breakdown_best <- bd1+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
    legend.position = "none",
    # szerszy margines z prawej strony
    plot.margin = margin(0, 30, 0, 0, "pt")
  )+
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL
  )
breakdown_best

ggsave(
  filename = "template_latex/rys/breakdown_best.pdf",
  plot = breakdown_best,
  width = width_single,
  height = height_single,
  units = unit,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
